subject: Extension request: PoC data connector stall (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@acme-analytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PoC blocked by connector errors — request for extension and credits

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from the Acme side — our PoC has hit a hard stop. Over the last 48 hours the Snowbridge connector to our accounting data has been returning a mix of 500s and malformed rows; engineers say the schema drift isn’t something we can patch quickly without more time. I’ve attached the connector_error_logs_20270310.zip and a small schema diff (schema_diff_v2.json).

We’re still excited about Redwood — the model outputs look promising — but this delay means our engineering sprint that was meant to validate outputs will slip. Can Redwood extend the sandbox by two weeks and bump our trial credits so we don’t get cut off while we sort this? Specifically: 
- 14-day extension to the PoC window
- +10k token sandbox credit

If you need anything else from our side (additional logs, temp test data), say the word and I’ll get it over. Appreciate any flexibility — want to keep momentum.

Best,
Lydia Chen
Product Manager, Acme Analytics

Attachments: connector_error_logs_20270310.zip (archive), schema_diff_v2.json (text)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by connector errors — request for extension and credits

Thanks, Lydia — and thanks for sending the logs. Sorry you hit this during the validation sprint. I’m looping in our engineering lead Nikhil and Marissa from CS so we can triage and figure out the fastest path forward.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Nikhil, can you confirm whether this looks like a transient connector issue or a schema change that’ll take several days to address?
2) Lydia, would you be open to a short technical alignment call (30 min) so our engineers can walk the logs with yours? We can make time tomorrow or Friday.

I’ll hold on the credits decision until we have an ETA, but we’re sympathetic — if this is an engineering blocker we’ll do what we can to keep the PoC moving.

— Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by connector errors — request for extension and credits

Quick triage notes after an initial pass on the logs Lydia sent:
- Root cause: schema drift plus an edge-case null array in the transactions feed results in our Snowbridge connector throwing a parsing error. Not a Redwood runtime bug, but it does require a small mapping change on our side and a config toggle to tolerate the null array.
- Estimated fix: 3 business days to push a tolerant parser + integration test and 1 day for coordination with Acme to flip the config and validate. Total ETA: 4–5 business days.

Recommendation to Sales/CS: grant a 14-day extension to the sandbox and add a 10k token credit to the PoC account. That gives Acme room to validate outputs after we ship the patch and avoids the risk of them losing momentum.

Also added: notes reference to HubSpot (ACME-449) and a small internal patch diff we can share if needed.

— Nikhil
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: small_patch_diff.patch (text)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, nikhil_sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by connector errors — request for extension and credits

Hi Lydia — thanks for the patience. 

We dug in with engineering and can do the following to keep your PoC on track: 
- Extend your PoC sandbox by 14 days from your current expiry date
- Apply a one-time 10,000 token sandbox credit to ACME-449 so you can finish validation once the connector is patched

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you accept the extension and credit (reply to this thread) and I’ll push the changes immediately.
2) If you’re up for it, let’s do a 30-minute handoff call Monday at 10am PT so our engineers can walk your team through the change.

I’ll also generate a short approval link for the credits so we have a paper trail — sending that in a follow-up (DocuSign-ish).

Appreciate you keeping us posted, and we’ll prioritize the patch.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-449
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@acme-analytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by connector errors — request for extension and credits

Thanks — that sounds great and we appreciate the quick turnaround. We accept the 14-day extension and the 10k token credit.

We’ve scheduled the handoff call for Monday 10am PT and I uploaded an extra log excerpt and a screenshot of the failing payload to the shared link (platform@acme-analytics.com).

Confirming acceptance here so you can proceed with the extension. Let me know if you need anything else from us before the call.

— Lydia
Product Manager, Acme Analytics
